acanthosis nigricans: Progression from light brown to dark gray
acrodermatitis enteropathica: Predilection for acral and periorificial sites
aplasia cutis: Focal absence of skin with granulation tissue
basal cell carcinoma: Irregular pigmented network with blue-gray globules
Atypical vascular pattern with linear vessels
Scaly erythematous patch with irregular borders
granuloma pyogenic: Dotted vessels, dotted network, focal pigment
hair loss photos alopecia and other hair: Fibrotic scalp with loss of follicles
nail psoriasis: Nail bed hyperkeratosis, loss of shine
Nail fold telangiectasia, capillary loop changes
